_about: Stage data for the trilogy second pass (Damian, 2026-11-11: 'Yes, inform the mining chat to collect info on the stages, too.'; concordance field 3 is a required field). Stage and operation node ids the stage relations may join; the miner mints a missing one as type Operation (a stage or operation) only where the paragraph names it. Relations: stage-of (an operation, symbol or substance to the stage it belongs to), precedes and follows (between stages, between operations, or between an operation and a stage). Every such candidate rests on a quote from the paragraph that says so; no stage or order is inferred.
